scientific notation.def: A number expressed as a coefficient with magnitude at least 1 and less than 10, times an integer power of ten.

arithmetic sequence.def: A sequence in which the difference between consecutive terms stays constant.

common difference.def: The fixed amount added to get the next term of an arithmetic sequence.

series.def: A sum of the terms of a sequence.

geometric sequence.def: A sequence in which the ratio between consecutive non-zero terms stays constant.

common ratio.def: The fixed multiplier that produces the next term of a geometric sequence.

depreciation.def: A reduction in an asset’s value. Percentage annual depreciation multiplies its value by a fixed fraction each year.

logarithm.def: The exponent to which a specified base must be raised to obtain a positive number.

deductive proof.def: An argument using accepted facts and valid logical steps to establish a claim for all stated cases.

identity.def: An equality that holds for every value for which its expressions are defined.

convergence.def: The approach of a sequence or series of partial sums to a finite limit.

binomial coefficient.def: The number of ways to choose r positions from n, written n choose r.

gradient.def: The change in output per unit change in input along a line.

function.def: A rule assigning exactly one output to each input in its domain.

domain.def: The set of permitted inputs of a function.

range.def: The set of outputs actually reached by a function on its domain.

inverse function.def: A function that reverses a one-to-one function, exchanging its inputs and outputs.

sketch.def: A graph showing the correct shape and labelled key features without requiring exact plotting of every point.

intersection.def: A point lying on two graphs: both functions have the same output for that input.

asymptote.def: A line describing the limiting behaviour of a graph as an input approaches a boundary or grows in magnitude.

composite function.def: A function obtained by applying one function to the output of another.

quadratic function.def: A polynomial function whose highest non-zero power is two.

discriminant.def: For a quadratic, b squared minus 4ac; its sign determines the number of real roots.

reciprocal function.def: The function that maps a non-zero input x to one divided by x.

analytical solution.def: An exact solution obtained by algebraic or other symbolic reasoning.

translation.def: A shift of a graph by a fixed horizontal and vertical amount.
